text_ar_search:
وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  يكثر أن يقول قبل موته 
"سبحان الله وبحمده، أستغفر الله، وأتوب إليه" ((متفق عليه)).
text_en: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: Prior to his demise, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to supplicate frequently: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi; Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilaihi (Allah is free from imperfection, and I begin with praising Him. I beg forgiveness from Allah and I turn to Him in repentance.".
